name: wendy-get-started
description: Get your first robot or edge device running, or try a simulator on your computer. No Wendy installation or Cloud account is needed to begin.

interface.shortDescription: Start with a device or demo
interface.longDescription: Build an app for a robot or edge device, or try a local simulator before your hardware arrives. ChatGPT helps you choose a starting point, install local tools when needed, and verify your first connection. Already have devices online? Use a hosted Wendy connection without installing a CLI.
defaultPrompt: Help me get started. I have not used Wendy before.
I want to try a robot simulator on my computer.
Help me build my first app for an edge device.
